(Japanese: '''カナタ''' ''Kanata'') and (Japanese: '''ミサキ''' ''Misaki'') are two minor characters who appeared in ''[[M15|Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice]]''. They first appeared battling each other in the [[Roshan City]] Pokémon Center. Although Kanata put up a good fight, Misaki ended up being the victor.
